```yaml
name: Close Inactive Issues

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *' # Runs daily at midnight UTC

jobs:
  close-inactive-issues:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Cancel previous runs
        uses: styfle/cancel-workflow-action@0.12.1
        with:
          workflow_id: ${{ github.workflow }}
          access_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install @actions/stale

      - name: Run stale action
        id: stale
        uses: actions/stale@v10
        with:
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          stale-issue-message: "This issue has been inactive for over 2 years. Please let us know if it is still relevant."
          close-issue-message: "This issue has been inactive for over 2 years and has been automatically closed."
          days-before-stale: 700
          days-before-issue-stale: 700
          days-before-close: 30
          days-before-issue-close: 30
          exempt-issue-labels: "data-issue"
          close-issue-reason: "inactivity"

      - name: Log results
        run: echo "Closed issues: ${{ steps.stale.outputs.closed-issues-prs }}, Staled issues: ${{ steps.stale.outputs.staled-issues-prs }}"
```
